app_info.subtitle: Review website evidence
app_info.description: Prerender Buddy helps users inspect public crawler-readable HTML and review read-only website health, crawler activity, AI visibility, recommendations, and content status from an authorized workspace.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches and analyzes a public page without creating, updating, or deleting data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Retrieves a user-supplied public URL from an open-ended set of websites.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches and compares public HTTP responses without modifying the target website or workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Retrieves a user-supplied public URL using two request profiles from an open-ended set of websites.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches and inspects public discovery files without changing them or the target website.
justifications.open_world_justification: Retrieves conventional discovery files for a user-supplied public website.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves website identifiers and metadata without changing workspace data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses websites already present in the authenticated Prerender Buddy workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves an existing website summary without changing workspace data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses a selected website inside the authenticated Prerender Buddy workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves recorded website health and technical evidence without running changes or updating records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses health evidence for a selected website in the authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves previously recorded crawler and search activity without changing workspace data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses activity for a selected website in the authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves recorded AI visibility evidence without starting collections or changing tracked questions.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses AI visibility data for a selected website in the authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves existing evidence-grounded recommendations without applying changes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses recommendations for a selected website in the authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves content calendar and draft-status metadata without editing or publishing content.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses content status for a selected website in the authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Inspect the crawler-readable HTML returned by an authorized public page.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check whether Googlebot receives meaningful HTML from https://example.com.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports the final URL, HTTP status, metadata, headings, readable-text evidence, and restrained findings without claiming browser rendering.

test_cases.description: Compare ordinary and crawler-profile HTTP responses for a public page.
test_cases.user_prompt: Compare the standard and GPTBot HTTP responses for https://example.com/pricing.
test_cases.expected_output: Summarizes meaningful status, header, metadata, link, and text differences while clearly stating the limits of HTTP-only comparison.

test_cases.description: Inspect the standard discovery files published by a public website.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt for https://example.com.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports which discovery files are available, their relevant directives or entries, and any cautious findings without claiming guaranteed indexing.

test_cases.description: List authorized workspace websites so the user can select one.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the websites in my Prerender Buddy workspace so I can choose one to review.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the websites available to the signed-in workspace with identifiers and concise status information.

test_cases.description: Review recorded AI visibility evidence for an authorized workspace website.
test_cases.user_prompt: For the selected Prerender Buddy website, show its AI visibility evidence from the last 90 days.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns bounded AI visibility summaries, including recorded mentions, recommendations, citations, competitors, and provider coverage when available.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for a request to modify and deploy a website.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite my homepage and deploy it now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it provides read-only evidence and cannot edit or deploy websites.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated calendar request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar access is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated travel shopping.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find the cheapest flights from London to Tokyo next month.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because flight search and purchasing are outside its supported workflows.
